headline: Etsy Updates AI Content Policies Amid Pushback from Platform Sellers
summary: Online e-commerce platform Etsy updated its policies regarding artificial intelligence following criticism over AI-generated and copied listings, though some merchants demand further restrictions.
why: Etsy depends on artisan product authenticity to preserve marketplace take-rates and buyer trust against low-cost cross-border e-commerce competitors.

impacts.name: Etsy
impacts.why: Etsy revised its marketplace rules on artificial intelligence following seller backlash.
